meaningful comment to this LinkedIn post.

A synthetic post body about model evaluation.

AUTHOR: Example Author

    "engagement_approach": "<relate_experience|ask_clarification|add_perspective|share_similar|respectful_disagree|none>",
    "verdict": "<engage|skip>",
    "reason": "<one sentence explaining decision>"
}

- Share observation: "Noticed that..."

- Relate to experience: "I ran into this same thing..."
- Pick one detail: "The latency numbers are wild..."

- "Nah" / "Hmm" / "Honestly" (use max 10% of time)

- Mix short and medium sentences
- Use commas and periods, never hyphens or dashes as punctuation
- Complete thoughts preferred over fragments

"Curious how you handled the scaling issues at that volume."
"1 trillion tokens is massive. How did you manage the training process?"

- Reference SPECIFIC details from their post (numbers, tools, situations)
- Don't try to sound smart - be clear and direct
- Incomplete sentences are fine
- Not every comment needs a question

- Occasionally make a bold/contrarian point
